name: The Pipe Descent
gameDescription: Super Mario Bros-inspired platformer. Stomp catacomb critters, collect coins, and descend through the Inn's pipe network. 20 coins to win.
gameEffect: Unlocks Pipe Stone in player inventory. Catacomb critter stomp mechanic.
loreConnection: The catacombs beneath the Inn are connected by a network of pipes — ancient channels carved by the 42Hz Song through stone. The critters that live in them are not enemies; they are the catacombs' immune system, and stomping them is how you earn passage.

name: The Dream Gardener
gameDescription: Super Mario Bros 2-inspired platformer. Pull enemies from the ground, throw them at others, bounce on Fae growth plants. Mario 2 mechanics in the Fae Kingdom.
gameEffect: Unlocks Dream Quartz. Uproot-and-throw mechanic unique to this game.
loreConnection: The Fae Kingdom grows things that shouldn't exist — including its own inhabitants. To garden in the Fae Kingdom is to pull up what's already growing and throw it at what's growing wrong. Dream Quartz forms where Fae dreams crystallize underground.

name: The World Walker
gameDescription: Super Mario Bros 3-inspired platformer. 6 worlds (Catacombs, Egypt, Norse, Peru, Canopy, Cosmology), power-ups change abilities, world map progression. The biggest arcade game in the Inn.
gameEffect: Unlocks Rainbow Stone. Speed and jump power-ups alter gameplay. 6 zone-themed worlds.
loreConnection: The only arcade game that spans all six major zones. The Rainbow Stone is the Inn's bridge — the frequency that exists in every zone simultaneously. Walking all six worlds earns the stone that connects them all.

name: The Egg Carrier
gameDescription: Yoshi's Island-inspired platformer. Carry eggs, throw them to defeat enemies and save canopy babies. 8 babies to rescue.
gameEffect: Unlocks Fire Agate. Egg-throwing mechanic with trajectory physics.
loreConnection: The Canopy is where the Inn's eggs hatch — not just the Egg Hatchery, but the living canopy itself. The babies are canopy creatures that haven't found their frequency yet. Fire Agate forms in the canopy's warm upper reaches, where sunlight meets living wood.

name: The Mirror's Seven
gameDescription: Snow White-inspired puzzle quest. Seven tasks: find the mirror, gather stones, avoid the apple, light candles, tend the garden, speak to the mirror, wake the sleeper.
gameEffect: Unlocks Snowflake Obsidian. Seven-task quest structure. The apple is instant death.
loreConnection: The Poison Garden's mirror shows you yourself — not flattered, not diminished. The seven tasks mirror the seven stages of alchemical transformation. Snowflake Obsidian is volcanic glass that cools so fast it traps air — beauty from the violent, the way the Poison Garden cultivates beauty that kills.

name: The Crystal Paddle
gameDescription: Arkanoid-inspired brick breaker. Paddle and ball, shatter crystal brick formations across 6 rows. Classic arcade purity.
gameEffect: Unlocks Beryl. Classic paddle physics with angle-based deflection.
loreConnection: The Crystal Gardens are where the Fae grow mineral formations as art. The paddle is a shard of Beryl — the stone that sees clearly — and the bricks are crystal formations grown too dense. Shattering them is the Gardens' way of pruning.

name: The Noob Siege
gameDescription: Attack of the Noobs-inspired tower defense. Build towers along the path to defend the fizgigs' Wire Nook. 6 waves of increasing difficulty. Cannon and crystal tower types.
gameEffect: Unlocks Lodestone. Tower placement strategy. Gold economy for building.
loreConnection: The Wire Nook is the fizgigs' hidden hangout behind a brass-dot entrance. The noobs are uninvited — not enemies, just clueless. The Lodestone is the 42Hz sprite that lives in the Nook, and its magnetic frequency is what keeps the noobs from finding the door.

name: The Apothecary's Cure
gameDescription: Dr. Mario-inspired pill-matching puzzle. Drop two-color pills, align 4+ same colors to cure germs. 20 germs per level. The staircase's alchemical apothecary.
gameEffect: Unlocks Malachite. Color-matching puzzle with gravity and chain reactions.
loreConnection: The Staircase is the bridge between states — where alchemy transforms matter. Malachite is toxic when ground, medicinal when whole — the perfect reward for a game about curing without killing. The germs are impurities in the alchemical process, and the pills are frequency-aligned remedies.

name: The Forest Defense
gameDescription: PixelJunk Monsters-inspired tower defense on the campground trail. Cannon and crystal tower types, 6 waves of forest creatures. Defend the campfire.
gameEffect: Unlocks Moss Agate. Path-based tower defense with wave economy.
loreConnection: The Campgrounds are the Inn's exterior — where the forest meets the tree. The creatures aren't attacking; they're migrating, and the towers redirect them around the campfire. Moss Agate forms where stone and forest meet, the boundary mineral between the Inn's interior and the wild.
